newsitem.title: FRANCE: France fears drop in aid for Africa.
newsitem.headline: France fears drop in aid for Africa.

text.p: Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Wednesday France was happy that African development was a priority for a summit of the Group of Seven nations in Denver in June but warned against a drop in public aid to African states.

"The increase of private aid, through private investments to Africa, should not serve as an excuse to reduce public aid which is equally necessary," Arthuis was quoted by an official as telling the weekly French cabinet meeting.
Arthuis reported to the cabinet about a weekend finance ministers' preparatory meeting in Washington to the June summit of leading industrialised nations.
